technology_name: A SWITCHED-INDUCTOR WITH CURRENT-SHARED NETWORK DC-DC CONVERTER FOR ON-BOARD ELECTRIC VEHICLES CHARGER
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional on-board EV chargers suffer from low voltage step-down ratios, thermal losses across switching elements, and require bulky component footprints that violate space constraints.
description: A highly compact power electronics converter topology utilizing a switched-inductor with a current-shared network (SICSN) DC-DC architecture, configured with optimized switching elements, shared inductors, and balancing diodes.
applications: On-board electric vehicle fast chargers, aerospace compact power management systems, micro-mobility charging docks, and distributed renewable energy storage grids.
secondary_sector: Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities, Robotics, Automation & Drones
